creator: Alexander Terp
description: An urgent post rings a working Claude Code only when the screen rule deciding it is a working rule carrying a prompt (detection engine 6). `live_turn_working` has one; `background_agents_working` ("Waiting for N background agents") does not, so an urgent post to an agent in that state waits for idle like an ordinary one. Give that rule a prompt and prompt_region the same way, with a recorded screen. Raised while building urgent posts, 2026-10-03.
title: 📨 An urgent post waits while Claude Code waits on background agents
